title: ctxloom profile
description: A profile file: .ctxloom/profiles/<name>.yaml, or a profile shipped inside a bundle. Every field is optional; a profile that declares none of them is refused at write time as empty.

description.description: Human-readable purpose, shown by `ctxloom profile list`.

llm.description: Preferred llm.configs label for runs using this profile (overridable by -l).

parents.description: Profiles this one inherits from. A bare name is a local profile; a bundle-profile ref is `<bundle>#profiles/<name>`.

tags.description: Descriptive tags for listing and discovery only. These do NOT select content — see select_tags.

select_tags.description: Fragment tags that SELECT content into the assembled context.

bundles.description: Bundle references contributing all of their content.

bundle_items.description: Cherry-picked items, e.g. `<bundle>#fragments/<name>`, optionally pinned with a trailing `@<commit>`.

fragments.description: Direct fragment references, each a bare name or a {name, priority} mapping.

commands.description: Curated slash-command exports (`<bundle>#commands/<name>`). A non-empty list suppresses the global auto-export for this profile.

skills.description: Curated Agent Skill exports (`<bundle>#skills/<name>`). A non-empty list suppresses the global auto-export for this profile.

variables.description: Template variables substituted into assembled content.

hooks.description: Hooks this profile declares. They pass the executable trust gate, since a profile may be bundle-shipped.

exclude_fragments.description: Fragments to drop after inheritance resolves.

exclude_mcp.description: MCP servers to drop after inheritance resolves.

deny_tools.description: Per-engine tool identifiers denied at launch. Accumulates through inheritance; a child cannot un-deny what a parent denied.
